fact: The higher-education ministry said that from the 2026-2027 academic year each student should have a personal AI-driven digital assistant, and that a large language model for university staff was in preparation; an interministerial roadmap for sovereign government AI models was adopted on 5 August 2026.
title: IA : L’Exécutif se mobilise autour d’une feuille de route en 5 axes
